summary: Frontend-only verification of the reported 'Failed to fetch' login bug fix. All 6 requested flows pass on the preview URL. The friendly network-error message is shown correctly (no raw 'Failed to fetch' leak), modal stays open, and recovery in the same modal (after unroute) succeeds without page reload. Regression flows (test-user login, admin login with Users nav visible, wrong-password error, live market terminal, new-user registration) all green.

issues: Recurring console warning 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — cosmetic, same as previous iteration; add minWidth/minHeight to Recharts ResponsiveContainer to silence.

test_results.1_login_test_user (reported bug): PASS — greeting 'Hello, Test User' appears; the 'Failed to fetch' scenario no longer reproduces under normal conditions.
test_results.2_register_new_account: PASS — signup lands in panel with greeting 'Hello, UI Reg User' (email uitest_reg_1787030328@onestock.in).
test_results.3_friendly_network_error: PASS — with page.route abort on /api/auth/login, auth-error shows exactly 'Cannot reach the server right now — it may be restarting. Please wait a few seconds and try again.'; NO 'Failed to fetch' leak; modal stays open.
test_results.4_recovery_same_modal: PASS — after page.unroute the same submit succeeds and lands in panel (no reload).
test_results.5a_admin_login: PASS — greeting 'Hello, Admin', ADMIN badge on user chip, Users nav item rendered in sidebar (verified visually + /me returns role=admin).
test_results.5b_wrong_password: PASS — auth-error shows 'Invalid email or password'.
test_results.5c_market_terminal_authenticated: PASS — Market Snapshot with LIVE badge and NIFTY/SENSEX/BANK NIFTY/FINNIFTY quotes renders while authenticated.

action_items: (Nit, carry-over) Silence Recharts 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on Dashboard by giving ResponsiveContainer a minWidth/minHeight.
critical_code_review_comments: friendlyAuthError implementation correctly maps TypeError('Failed to fetch') and net::ERR_* / AbortError to the user-visible copy; verified end-to-end via route.abort simulation.
AuthModal keeps the dialog open on error and clears the error state on retry — good UX for the transient outage scenario reported by the user.
AuthContext.login sets user state synchronously from the login response (includes role) so the panel gates render immediately without a second /me round-trip — no race observed for admin nav.

Note: my earlier test used data-testid 'desktop-admin-users' which returned count=0 while the 'Users' menu item is clearly rendered — the prefix constant used by the sidebar for desktop may differ from 'desktop'; NOT a product bug, but consider aligning the desktop sidebar prefix to 'desktop' for testability (currently only mobile sidebar seems to expose that testid pattern).
seed_data_creation: Registered one throwaway user via UI: uitest_reg_1787030328@onestock.in — safe to purge alongside other uitest_/test_ accounts.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reported 'Failed to fetch' bug is verified fixed. friendlyAuthError copy is now surfaced in AuthModal (auth-error) and AuthCallback toast. If retesting friendly-error, use page.route('**/api/auth/login', lambda r: r.abort()) then unroute for recovery. Admin sidebar Users item test: prefer get_by_text('Users', exact=True) or inspect the actual prefix — 'desktop-admin-users' testid returned 0 despite the item being rendered.
rca of the issue: Original user report was a transient outage (all pod services restarted simultaneously ~44s uptime) causing the browser fetch to throw a TypeError('Failed to fetch'). No login backend defect. Fix by main agent surfaces a friendly copy instead of the raw browser error and keeps the modal open for retry; verified with page.route abort simulation and clean recovery on unroute.
